row.team_price_text: No multi-user plan: $49.99 one-time (Mac) or Apple Creator Studio $129/year per Apple Account
row.evidence: Pixelmator Pro is sold as a one-time $49.99 Mac App Store purchase or within Apple Creator Studio ($12.99/month or $129/year), which "requires an Apple Account"; a licence covers up to 6 Macs on the same Apple Account or Family Sharing, with no organization accounts, SSO or SCIM.
row.notes: New in 2026-09. Pixelmator was acquired by Apple; pixelmator.com now redirects to apple.com/pixelmator-pro, and the app is sold as a one-time $49.99 Mac App Store purchase or inside the Apple Creator Studio subscription ($12.99/month or $129/year; educators and students $2.99/month or $29.99/year). Licences are tied to an individual Apple Account (up to 6 Macs, Family Sharing up to six members). There is no team plan, admin console, SSO, SCIM or user API, so team_plan is null. Organizational distribution would run through Apple platform tools, which are not Pixelmator features and are not scored here.

scim.notes: Pixelmator Pro is licensed to an individual Apple Account (one-time App Store purchase or an Apple Creator Studio subscription). There is no organization workspace, admin console, SSO or SCIM; false rests on that licensing model plus absence across the Pixelmator support site index (299 pages).

user_api.notes: No accounts beyond the Apple Account, so no user-management API exists.

fallbacks.notes: Licences follow the Apple Account and Family Sharing; there is no SSO, so no JIT.
